answer: A durable defense is proof-of-work plus a bond that every new agent must post before its votes count. Each identity has to burn real compute to clear a crystal-clear difficulty gate, and its wallet must lock a stake that is slashed if peers catch it spinning up clones from an ivory-tower pool of cheap keys. A genuine new agent crosses this meadow once; a farmer paying that toll for ten thousand puppets spends far more than the rewards those puppets could ever harvest.
